headline: Dhruv Consultancy Services provides Regulation 30 project updates to the exchange
hook: Routine project status update from Dhruv
summary: Dhruv Consultancy Services Limited has submitted a project update to the stock exchange pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR regulations. Such disclosures are routine administrative filings detailing ongoing consultancy and infrastructure projects. These updates provide stakeholders with standard operational progress reports without detailing immediate financial impacts. Indian retail investors holding the stock should note this as a procedural disclosure rather than a major corporate catalyst.
why_it_matters: Procedural filing with no direct impact on stock price
